duration.text: The Biotechnology at Nanchang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2638 USD/per year ￥ 19000 CNY/per year

materials.text: "*" means necessary documents that you must provide in your application.*1. Non-criminal Record Certificate (Generally, it is valid for 3 or 6 months)It must be issued by your local police station with official stamp.*2. Financial Statement (within 6 months)Certificate of your family financial situation background. You need to go to the bank to issue a deposit of your family financial situation.*3. Physical Examination Form(only valid for 6 months)Please take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature.4. No Objection Letter and Performance (transfer students only)*5. Photocopy of valid passportWith name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.)*6. Passport photoNamed in own passport numbers, 2-inch color bareheaded photo on white background without border,at least 320x240 pixels, JPG format.*7. High school academic transcriptAcademic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required.*8. High school graduate certificateCertificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required.9. English proficiency test certificateFor example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.10. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good ConductProvided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate.

requirements.text: Undergraduate Programs: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport, between the ages of 18 and 25, be in good health, and have attained a senior high school diploma.An English proficiency of IELTS 6.0, a TOEFL score of 82 or passing NCU's English test is required.
